story.title: Our Story
origins: The story of Camp Bali started nearly two decades ago when our family made a life-changing move to Bali. Seeking an escape from the rat race, we wanted our three children to deeply connect with their Indonesian roots. While our initial plan was to establish an IT business, high internet costs at the time led us in a new direction.

Partnering with the Bali Appropriate Technology Institute through our company, Consultek, we set out to produce and market high-quality Virgin Coconut Oil (VCO). We were proud pioneers as the first VCO producers in Bali, and reaching the shelves of Bali Buddha marked a major milestone. Over the years, we have expanded into a variety of oils, natural foods, and spa products, with VCO remaining the core of our brand.

timeline.title: Pioneering VCO in Bali

timeline.title: Product & Village Expansion
timeline.text: Expanded product lines into natural foods, spa, and wellness items while establishing direct sourcing networks in local villages.

timeline.title: Sustainable Futures
timeline.text: Continuing to innovate with new products aimed at revitalizing agricultural economies in rural communities.

ethos.title: Our Ethos: Aid Through Business
ethos.intro: We operate on a simple yet powerful conviction: "Aid through Business." We actively partner with local growers, farmers, and artisans across village communities, sourcing raw ingredients and manufacturing locally whenever possible. By supporting sustainable business models, we help strengthen rural economies and empower local communities.
ethos.mission: To create high-quality, pure natural oils and wellness products while nurturing sustainable livelihoods for rural Indonesian communities.

pillars.title: Aid Through Business
